findings.title: `reasoning_effort` leaves out "minimal", which GPT-5 supports.
findings.body: The linked issue is about GPT-5 models, which accept `reasoning_effort="minimal"`. The Pydantic `Literal["low", "medium", "high"]` here rejects that value. A config like the one in the issue with `"reasoning_effort": "minimal"` will make `ChatCompletionClient.load_component` raise a `ValidationError`. The `CreateArguments` TypedDict on line 53 has the same omission, so type checkers will flag direct constructor calls that pass `"minimal"`. The PR description says both models include "minimal", but the diff does not. Fix: add "minimal" to both Literals and to the valid-values loop in the test.
